planNote: Verify all four witnesses with core sightline, robustness, gaze, and render checks, plus timing/speed sensitivity analyses for contested Witness B, time-sensitive Witness A, and partially blocked Witness D.

tasks.why: Independently verify the entire local check suite on a clean sandbox.
Confirm the perception-reaction time available to the colliding drivers over the hill crest.
Confirm Witness A had a clear view of Car A at t=4.0s before the semitrailer blocked the eastbound lanes.
Verify that Witness A's sightline to Car A at t=4.0s is robust across position tolerances.
Check that Car A falls within Witness A's central field of view while driving eastbound.
Determine the exact time window when the turning semitrailer cuts off Witness A's view of Car A.
Test Witness B's contested claim of an unobstructed view of Car A right up until impact.
Find how far Witness B would need to move from the bench shelter to see Car A.
Evaluate Witness B's peripheral 29.5-degree gaze angle toward Car A and alternate marks.
Check whether Witness B had a clear sightline to Car A at any time within 2 seconds of t=9.9s.
Test whether any reasonable variation in Car A's speed would clear the obstruction for Witness B.
Confirm Witness C's unobstructed view of the semitrailer swinging across the eastbound lanes at impact.
Verify that Witness C's view from the westbound inside lane is unaffected by minor position shifts.
Confirm the semitrailer is directly within Witness C's forward gaze.
Confirm Witness D's statement that she could not see the collision from behind the store register.
Investigate the partial robustness (23/25 blocked) to see where inside the store a sightline opens up.
Check Witness D's gaze alignment toward the highway from behind the counter.
Verify whether Car A was blocked from Witness D's position across the entire ±2s window around impact.
Render the overhead scene layout to confirm vehicle trajectories and obstruction geometry.
Render Witness A's perspective at t=4.0s to visually confirm pixel visibility of Car A.
Render Witness B's perspective at t=9.9s to visually confirm occlusion by the bench shelter and truck.
Render Witness C's perspective at t=10.43s to verify visibility of the turning semitrailer.
Render Witness D's interior store perspective to confirm the retail building and fixtures block the highway.
